Replace.Text: Determines how long Players have to take their Turn. [n]None - Players take Turns without time constraints.[n]Standard - Turn time is based on the Turn Time option (in seconds). [n]Dynamic - Turn time is dynamically scaled based on the number of Cities and Units in play. [n]Competitive - Turn time scales with Cities, Units, human Players and the current Turn, tuned per Age. Warning tones begin at 30 seconds; the Turn ends automatically at zero.

Row.Text: Turn time scales with the Cities and Units in play, the number of human Players, and the current Turn, tuned per Age.

The kind of match. It decides where players start, and the team matches also set Start Position, Strict Start Biases and Map Size. Free for All places players over the whole map and leaves the other settings to the host.
Players start anywhere on the map (Fresh Water, 12 tiles apart); choose the other settings yourself.
Duel placement (West vs East), Balanced starts, Strict Start Biases, Tiny map built as the 36x22 Duel map.
2v2 placement (teams 1-2-1-2 by slot: backline, then frontline), Balanced starts, Strict Start Biases, Tiny map.
3v3 placement (teams 1-2-1-2-1-2 by slot), Balanced starts, Strict Start Biases, Small map.
4v4 placement (teams 1-2-1-2-1-2-1-2 by slot), Balanced starts, Strict Start Biases, Standard map.
